def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    initial_units = 200000
    new_units = 220000
    price_per_unit = 250
    variable_cost_per_unit = 65
    fixed_operating_costs = 10000000

    # Calculate operating income at each output level
    contribution_margin_per_unit = price_per_unit - variable_cost_per_unit
    initial_operating_income = (
        initial_units * contribution_margin_per_unit - fixed_operating_costs
    )
    new_operating_income = (
        new_units * contribution_margin_per_unit - fixed_operating_costs
    )

    # Calculate the percentage change in operating income
    percentage_change = (
        (new_operating_income - initial_operating_income)
        / initial_operating_income
        * 100
    )
    answer = round(percentage_change, 2)

    # return answer
    return answer
